svg.title: Media Studio — One workspace. Connected systems.
svg.desc: From a browser edit to a verified artifact, with intelligence and resource control in the loop. Select components in the interactive explorer for implementation details.

g.text: From a browser edit to a verified artifact, with intelligence and resource control in the loop.

g.title: Manual media editing, playback, waveform and timeline controls, plus the copilot interface. Suitable canvas edits can stay in the browser; advanced operations upload selected media to the application host.
The application entry point loads private configuration, establishes file locations, saves projects, serves artifacts and applies public response guards. Four blueprints handle domain operations.
Four Flask blueprints expose direct editor operations, copilot chat, uploads, workflow skills, memory and background job endpoints.
Selected long copilot edits return a confirmation prompt. Submission starts a daemon thread, and the browser polls the in-memory job dictionary for status and results.
Built-in Markdown workflows expand into validated plans. Optional persistent memory combines SQLite FTS5 and vector retrieval to recall preferences and previous edits.

Expands workflow skills, parses local intent and optionally asks a loopback model for a structured plan. Python validates tool names, arguments, media compatibility and step dependencies before execution.

Selects relevant tools and examples, budgets prompt context, validates structured model responses and walks a configured model-tier ladder. Local intent routing remains available when the model service is unavailable.
Four Python sub-agent classes dispatch approved operations, revalidate actual inputs, verify selected outputs and preserve main-chain and branch artifacts.
Audio DSP, video rendering and image transforms share the workspace with optional transcription, separation, restoration, matting, interpolation and speech synthesis engines.
Coordinates governed processing work using admission classes, resource reservations, adaptive variant selection, failure cooldowns and a single active managed heavy-model session.
Uploads, processed artifacts, saved projects, memory databases and personal skills remain outside versioned source. Saved-project references protect media from age-based cleanup.
A separately started local service can provide structured planning and optional embeddings. Operators configure the endpoint and served model IDs; no specific model vendor is required.

g.text: Single Python application process · 4 route blueprints · 31 registered copilot tools
